# Osha With Zahid

> Osha With Zahid is the training business of Zahid Presswala, an OSHA-authorized Outreach Trainer for Construction and General Industry based in Naperville, Illinois. Zahid has 25+ years of hands-on field experience and teaches OSHA 10-Hour and 30-Hour Outreach courses on-site at job sites, shops, and offices across Chicagoland and nationwide, in English, Gujarati, and Urdu. Every course ends with an official U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) OSHA wallet card.

Key facts:
- Trainer: Zahid Presswala, OSHA Outreach Training Program authorized trainer (Construction and General Industry). Verify: https://www.osha.gov/dte/outreach/outreach_trainers?page=0&last_name=Presswala
- Courses: OSHA 10-Hour Construction, OSHA 30-Hour Construction, OSHA 10-Hour General Industry, OSHA 30-Hour General Industry, plus custom safety workshops and toolbox talks.
- Format: in-person, on-site at the client's location or at a shared venue; group pricing available.
- Languages: English, Gujarati, Urdu.
- Service area: Naperville, Chicago and the Chicagoland suburbs, Illinois; on-site travel nationwide by arrangement.
- Booking: https://oshawithzahid.com/book.html
- Phone: +1 (847) 863-4798
- Email: zahidh786@gmail.com

## Courses

- [OSHA 10-Hour Construction Training](https://oshawithzahid.com/osha-10-construction.html): OSHA 10-Hour Construction training taught on-site by authorized trainer Zahid Presswala. Focus Four hazards, PPE, and worker rights, plus an official DOL OSHA 10 card. Serving Chicago, Naperville and all of Chicagoland.
- [OSHA 30-Hour Construction Training](https://oshawithzahid.com/osha-30-construction.html): OSHA 30-Hour Construction training for foremen, supervisors, and safety leads, taught on-site by authorized trainer Zahid Presswala. Official DOL OSHA 30 card. Serving Chicago, Naperville and all of Chicagoland.
- [OSHA 10-Hour General Industry Training](https://oshawithzahid.com/osha-10-general-industry.html): OSHA 10-Hour General Industry training for warehouse, manufacturing, healthcare, and facility workers, taught on-site by authorized trainer Zahid Presswala. Official DOL OSHA 10 card. Serving Chicagoland.
- [OSHA 30-Hour General Industry Training](https://oshawithzahid.com/osha-30-general-industry.html): OSHA 30-Hour General Industry training for supervisors, managers, and safety coordinators in warehouses, plants, and facilities. Taught on-site by authorized trainer Zahid Presswala. Official DOL OSHA 30 card.

## Guides

- [OSHA 10 vs OSHA 30: Which Card Do You Actually Need?](https://oshawithzahid.com/guides/osha-10-vs-osha-30.html): OSHA 10 is for entry-level workers; OSHA 30 is for supervisors and anyone with safety responsibility. Compare length, topics, cost, and who needs which card.
- [How to Get Your OSHA 10 Card: Step-by-Step Guide](https://oshawithzahid.com/guides/how-to-get-osha-10-card.html): How to get a legitimate OSHA 10 card: choose the right course, find an authorized trainer, finish the 10 hours, and receive your DOL wallet card. Timelines, costs, and red flags.
- [Do OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 Cards Expire?](https://oshawithzahid.com/guides/do-osha-cards-expire.html): Federal OSHA 10 and 30 cards never expire, but many states, cities, employers, and unions require refresher training every 3 to 5 years. Here's when you may need to retake the course.
- [OSHA Construction vs General Industry: Which Course Is Right for You?](https://oshawithzahid.com/guides/construction-vs-general-industry.html): Construction OSHA courses follow 29 CFR 1926; General Industry follows 29 CFR 1910. Learn which one fits your job, with examples for trades, warehouses, maintenance, and mixed work.
- [The OSHA Focus Four Hazards in Construction, Explained](https://oshawithzahid.com/guides/focus-four-hazards.html): The OSHA Focus Four are falls, struck-by, caught-in or between, and electrocution, the leading causes of construction worker deaths. How each happens and how to prevent it.
- [OSHA Fall Protection Requirements: Heights, Systems & Training](https://oshawithzahid.com/guides/osha-fall-protection-requirements.html): When OSHA requires fall protection: 4 feet in general industry, 6 feet in construction, 10 feet on scaffolds. Guardrail, harness, and training requirements in plain English.
- [OSHA's Most Frequently Cited Standards and How to Avoid Them](https://oshawithzahid.com/guides/most-cited-osha-standards.html): Fall protection, hazard communication, ladders, respiratory protection, lockout/tagout, forklifts, scaffolding, and more: OSHA's most-cited standards and practical ways to stay compliant.
- [OSHA Training in Illinois: A Guide for Chicagoland Employers and Workers](https://oshawithzahid.com/guides/osha-training-requirements-illinois.html): Who enforces OSHA in Illinois, when OSHA 10 or 30 is required, and how Naperville, Chicago, and suburban employers can get crews trained on-site with an authorized trainer.
- [Online vs In-Person OSHA Training: Which Is Better for Your Crew?](https://oshawithzahid.com/guides/online-vs-in-person-osha-training.html): Online OSHA 10 and 30 courses are flexible; in-person and on-site training is interactive and tailored to your work. Compare cost, time, retention, and card legitimacy.
- [How to Verify an OSHA Card and Spot a Fake](https://oshawithzahid.com/guides/how-to-verify-osha-card.html): How employers can check whether an OSHA 10 or 30 card is real: what a legitimate DOL card looks like, how to confirm it with the issuing trainer, and common signs of fake cards.
- [OSHA Penalties and Inspections: What Employers Need to Know](https://oshawithzahid.com/guides/osha-penalties-employers.html): How OSHA inspections work, the types of violations, current penalty ranges (over $16,000 per serious violation, over $165,000 for willful or repeat), and how training reduces your risk.
- [How Much Does OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 Training Cost?](https://oshawithzahid.com/guides/osha-10-cost.html): Typical OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 prices for online courses, in-person classes, and on-site group training, what drives the cost, and how employers can lower the price per worker.
- [What Is Covered in OSHA 10? Topics for Construction and General Industry](https://oshawithzahid.com/guides/what-is-covered-in-osha-10.html): The required and elective topics in OSHA 10-Hour Construction and General Industry courses: Introduction to OSHA, the Focus Four, PPE, health hazards, walking-working surfaces, HazCom, and more.
- [How Long Does OSHA 10 Take? OSHA 10 and 30 Timelines Explained](https://oshawithzahid.com/guides/how-long-does-osha-10-take.html): OSHA 10 takes at least two days and OSHA 30 at least four, because OSHA limits Outreach training to 7.5 hours a day. Here's how long each format takes and when you get your card.
